summary: NCTA supports the E‑Rate program, calls for stronger consultant oversight, opposes an ETC requirement and other proposals that would limit funding, and urges the Commission to preserve special construction and high‑cost area eligibility. The comment argues for broader eligibility, maintaining special construction, and stronger consultant oversight, while opposing restrictions on rural service and percentage‑based fees. NCTA urges the FCC to strengthen oversight of consultants, tighten cost‑effectiveness controls for Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS), and prevent service‑substitution approvals from delaying reimbursements, while rejecting any harmful structural changes to the E‑Rate program.
